verdict.rationale: Adyen In-Person Payments is a payments platform (Terminal API, terminals, Tap to Pay), not an AI agent or LLM host, so consuming third-party MCP servers' tools is outside its product category. The evidence shows Adyen publishes its own MCP server for LLM clients, which is the server role and a separate story; nothing shows the product acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
